svg.title: Prompt comparison: low faithfulness grows from 11 to 34 of 99
svg.text: Counts compare Grounded → Open-book. Dots show Open-book.

svg.aria-label: Open-book prompt, 99 questions. Low recall and high faithfulness: 10 questions; High recall and high faithfulness: 55 questions; Low recall and low faithfulness: 16 questions; High recall and low faithfulness: 18 questions. Counts compare Grounded to Open-book: 21 to 10, 67 to 55, 5 to 16, and 6 to 18 in the same quadrant order. Low faithfulness increases from 11 to 34 of 99 questions. Recall target: 0.5. Faithfulness target: 0.8. Each dot represents one question; question identities across prompts were not recorded.
